issues.title: Crawl stopped early: page limit
issues.howToFix: Re-run the audit with a higher page limit. If it is already at the maximum, add a robots.txt group for the "OpenSEO-Audit" user agent that disallows sections you don't need audited, such as tag archives or filtered listings, so the limit goes to the pages that matter: https://openseo.so/docs/crawler
